# Real apps the tests scan when a fixture cache is given. They are never
# stored in this repository: each line pins one by the SHA-256 of its file,
# the name it has in the cache, and where its publisher offers it.
#
#   cargo xtask fixtures fetch --dir DIR
#   EXPOSURE_FIXTURE_CACHE=DIR cargo test -p exposure --test android_real_apps
#
